Step 1: Calculate the total distance Jon drives in a 30-day month. He drives 100 miles a day, so for 30 days, the total distance is $100 \text{ miles/day} \times 30 \text{ days} = 3000 \text{ miles}$.

Step 2: Determine how many tune-ups are needed for this total distance. His car needs a tune-up every 1000 miles. 

Step 3: Divide the total miles driven by the miles per tune-up: $3000 \text{ miles} / 1000 \text{ miles/tune-up} = 3 \text{ tune-ups}$.

Final answer: 3
